items.title: Marriott’s Dividend Yields 0.7%. Its $4.8 Billion Cash Return Plan Changes the Math
items.summary: A sub-1% yield makes Marriott look like a poor pick for income investors. The real payout hides in a place most dividend screens never check, and one quirk on its balance sheet could test how long it lasts.

items.title: What these CEOs think about the midterm election results
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi looks back on how business leaders are viewing the Democrats' midterm victories and whether it will affect their business. This includes commentary from Hilton Worldwide (HLT) CEO Chris Nassetta, Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) CEO Lisa Su, and more executives who spoke to Yahoo Finance.

items.title: AMD CEO Su on earnings outlook, new Starbucks holiday menu, and Hilton CEO on hotel demand
items.summary:
Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi tackles the biggest news of the market day, including AMD's (AMD) earnings outlook topping estimates as chip demand soars, what the blue wave in Congress means for a market rally, and how Starbucks (SBUX) plans its business around the holiday season with new products. 

Sozzi also goes 1-on-1 with Hilton (HLT) CEO Chris Nassetta to discuss AI's impact on the hospitality industry.

items.title: Marriott International Earnings Ahead: What Past Reactions Say About The Stock
items.summary: Marriott International (NASDAQ:MAR) is scheduled to report its earnings on Monday, November 2, 2026. The company has a market value of about $105.5 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $26.9 billion in revenue and $4.2 billion in operating profit, with net income of $2.6 billion.
